summary: Completed full e2e testing for the 4 new features (OCR, Hospitality PDF, Excel/CSV Import-Export, Data Exchange UI) plus the refactored modular backend architecture. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: all key flows pass (login, sidebar navigation, OCR button in Add Tenant form, Data Exchange 3 sections, Export/Template/Import buttons, Hospitality PDF download, Dashboard, Rooms, Import dialog).

issues: Missing `aria-describedby` on DialogContent (accessibility warning in console). Non-blocking, but should be addressed by providing a Description element or explicit aria-describedby.

action_items: Optional: Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to Tenants Add/Edit and Import DialogContent to silence accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py contains two login paths (/login direct and /login-step1 + /verify-otp). Currently the frontend uses /login (direct, no OTP). Confirm with product whether OTP flow is intentionally dormant and remove dead code if not needed, to reduce attack surface.

CAPTCHA is bypassed when captcha_token is empty (both on /login and /login-step1). Since RECAPTCHA_SECRET is set, consider requiring a non-empty captcha_token in production to prevent brute force at the token layer (the IP-based rate limiter and BF lockout still protect credentials).
All new routes (ocr, hospitality, data_exchange) are correctly prefixed with /api and protected via Depends(get_current_user). MongoDB _id is consistently excluded with projections. Good.
OCR endpoint accepts files up to 10MB and validates content-type; service call depends on emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (configured).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (new test suite for OCR, Hospitality PDF, Data Exchange)

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 new-feature tests passed; prior 40/40 suite still valid)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_* tenants created and cleaned up within tests (module-scoped fixture + import cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth uses direct /api/auth/login with email+password+captcha_token (empty token is accepted because RECAPTCHA_SECRET falls-open on error or empty). Cookies httpOnly. Tenant create requires fields: full_name, email, phone, whatsapp, passport_number, nationality, date_of_birth, gender, place_of_birth, passport_issue_date, passport_expiry_date, address, occupation, codice_fiscale. Hospitality PDF endpoint is GET /api/hospitality/pdf/{tenant_id} (accepts optional check_in_date/check_out_date query). Data export endpoints return .xlsx (PK signature). Import accepts .xlsx/.xls/.csv. OCR endpoint accepts image/jpeg|png|webp up to 10MB. Frontend testids: nav-gestione dati, data-exchange-page, export-inquilini-btn, template-inquilini-btn, import-inquilini-btn, export-pagamenti-btn, template-pagamenti-btn, import-pagamenti-btn, export-occupazione-btn, hospitality-pdf-button, add-tenant-button, tenant-row-{id}.
